text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Trainer!! What a great 
morning~~!!
choice_data_list: You're even more energetic than usual.

You're full of even more energy than 
usual!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right! Actually, I bumped 
into the President yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got praised! They told me, "Looks like 
you've been working hard!"♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to sleep so 
peacefully and soundly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep trying hard and get praised 
a whole bunch! Ohh, yeah!

Tokai Teio ran off, looking even more 
energetic than usual.
